secrets.label: Cloudflare deploy token
secrets.what: Lets GitHub deploy the Worker and copy the other keys to Cloudflare. It is the one key that cannot be copied for you.
secrets.howToGet: Cloudflare dashboard > My Profile > API Tokens > Create Token > use the template 'Edit Cloudflare Workers' > account: yours > Continue > Create. Copy the token once, with the Copy button (an Account API token from Manage Account works too).

secrets.label: Signing key
secrets.what: Signs one-tap approval links, dashboard sign-in cookies and tester beta codes. Random; you never type it.
usedBy: App repos, as APPROVAL_SIGNING_KEY, to make approval links

secrets.label: Worker's GitHub token
secrets.what: Lets the Worker add the ai-fix label, file issues from feedback, and read pull requests and runs for the dashboard.
secrets.howToGet: GitHub > Settings > Developer settings > Fine-grained tokens > Generate. Owner: you. Repositories: only the app repos. Permissions: Issues Read and write, Pull requests Read, Actions Read. Pick an expiry and note it.

secrets.label: Dashboard passphrase
secrets.what: Protects the dashboard. Only a salted hash is stored, never the passphrase itself.
secrets.howToGet: You choose it: at least ten characters, for example four random words.

secrets.label: Triage AI key
secrets.what: Lets the AI turn a tester's message into a clean, anonymous issue. Without it, feedback from the app cannot be processed.
secrets.howToGet: Your Anthropic key from console.anthropic.com > API keys (the same key as the agent's is fine), or a key for another provider set in wrangler.toml.

secrets.label: Phone progress topic
secrets.what: Private ntfy channel for quiet progress messages such as 'Approved, starting' and 'Done'. The topic name is its own password.
usedBy: App repos, as NTFY_PROGRESS_TOPIC, for 'Done' messages
secrets.howToGet: Generated for you. Then subscribe to the name it prints in the ntfy app.

secrets.label: Web push key
secrets.what: Lets the Worker send push notifications to the installed web app. Only needed for the push test and the future installable dashboard.

secrets.label: Agent's Anthropic key
secrets.what: Lets the AI agent write the change for an issue. Each app repo needs its own copy, because GitHub shows a repo's secrets only to that repo.
usedBy: App repos: the fix workflow (agent run and preflight)
secrets.howToGet: console.anthropic.com > API keys > Create key. Set a monthly spend limit.

secrets.label: Phone 'needs you' topic
secrets.what: Private ntfy channel for messages that need you: Approve fix?, PR ready, Run failed. The topic name is its own password.
usedBy: App repos: approval request and result messages
secrets.howToGet: Make up a long random name (at least 16 characters) and subscribe to it in the ntfy app.

secrets.label: Approval signing key (copy)
secrets.what: A copy of the signing key so the app's workflow can make one-tap approval links. Set automatically whenever the signing key is set.

secrets.label: Phone progress topic (copy)
secrets.what: A copy of the progress topic so the fix workflow can send 'Done'. Set automatically with the Worker's topic.

secrets.label: Read access to a private harness repo
secrets.what: Only needed if the harness repo is private: lets an app's workflows fetch the harness scripts. The harness repo is public today, so this is not set.
usedBy: App repos: fix and approval workflows, to download the harness
secrets.howToGet: GitHub > Settings > Developer settings > Fine-grained tokens > read-only access to the harness repo.
